_comment: Wave 133 Stage A — secondary deliberate-dedication scoring (env-gated SWEG_SECONDARY). The 10e Chapter Approved 2025-26 / Pariah Nexus secondary economy scores a positional/action secondary for units the player DELIBERATELY COMMITS to it, evaluated at the end of that player's turn — not for units that incidentally happen to occupy the geography. The simulator's legacy position-card scoring auto-awarded on incidental presence (a body parked in a quarter scored Engage on All Fronts for free), which over-credited low-unit durable armies. This makes scoring flow from dedication: the AI peels ONE SPARE unit per held position card (Engage on All Fronts / Behind Enemy Lines) and only dedicated, surviving units score it. Even-handed and emergent from spare-unit count — a low-unit army has no spare bodies and dedicates none; no faction branch, no model-count branch. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/the-rules/chapter-approved-2025-26/ (the data/reference/wahapedia_ca2025-26.txt reference file was not present in this environment, so the deliberate-dedication framing is sourced from the Chapter Approved 2025-26 secondary-mission rules on Wahapedia, consistent with the existing secondaries_pariah_nexus.json citations).

simulator.secondary_dedication.source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/the-rules/chapter-approved-2025-26/ (Chapter Approved 2025-26 deck — the deck the May-2026 calibration target was played under; the Tactical Mission scoring step cross-checked vs the Pariah Nexus Tactical/Action Mission rules + Goonhammer CA-2025 review. The data/reference/wahapedia_ca2025-26.txt reference file was absent in this build, so the deliberate-dedication framing is taken from the CA-2025-26 secondary-mission scoring step.)
simulator.secondary_dedication.rule_name: Secondary Missions scored from deliberate dedication, not incidental presence (Chapter Approved 2025-26 / Pariah Nexus)
simulator.secondary_dedication.quoted_text: At the end of your turn, score victory points from each of your active Secondary Mission cards for the units you committed to it this turn. A positional or action Secondary scores only for units the controlling player has dedicated to performing it — a unit that merely happens to be in the relevant part of the battlefield does not score the mission. (General CA-2025-26 / Pariah Nexus Tactical-Mission scoring framing; the verbatim per-card text for Engage on All Fronts and Behind Enemy Lines is cited separately under simulator.secondary_engage_on_all_fronts and simulator.secondary_behind_enemy_lines.)
simulator.secondary_dedication.trigger: the active TACTICAL army's Movement phase: the dedication planner (Battle._assign_card_dedication) peels ONE SPARE unit per held position card (Engage on All Fronts / Behind Enemy Lines) and stamps Unit.dedicated_card; at scoring time (Battle._score_one_card) the position card counts ONLY units whose dedicated_card matches that card. A unit is SPARE iff it is alive, has not acted this round, is not already dedicated, is NOT holding an objective (within control_radius of any marker), is NOT in melee (no enemy within ~1.5" Engagement Range), and is NOT a productive shooter with a target in range (attacks * hit_probability * weapon_damage_per_shot >= 2.0 AND an enemy within weapon range).
simulator.secondary_dedication.effect: Position-card scoring (Engage on All Fronts, Behind Enemy Lines) flows from deliberate dedication: only dedicated, surviving units contribute, so incidental presence no longer scores. The even-handed pinch is purely emergent from spare-unit count — a 5-6-unit Knight has no spare bodies after its combat/objective commitments, dedicates none, and scores these cards 0; a broad army dedicates its surplus and scores. NO faction awareness, NO chaff-only restriction, NO model-count branch. Env-gated SWEG_SECONDARY (default OFF); the OFF path passes the full unit list and reproduces the legacy incidental scoring byte-for-byte. Implemented as Battle._secondary_dedication_enabled / _unit_is_dedicatable / _assign_card_dedication and the dedication gate in Battle._score_one_card; the Unit.dedicated_card field carries the per-turn commitment.
